title: Mermaid Diagrams in Markdown, Thread Deletion Shortcuts, Real-Time Git Status Sync & Catppuccin Mocha Default
summary: Introduces native theme-aware Mermaid diagram rendering with zoom/pan and full-screen controls in Markdown preview, thread deletion shortcuts and palette actions, instant Git status tree synchronization after staging and commits, non-disruptive auto-updates with manual restart notices, and sets Catppuccin Mocha as the default workbench theme.

categories.name: Mermaid Diagrams & Markdown Preview
items: Render fenced mermaid blocks as interactive, theme-aware diagrams with automatic SVG color adaptation
Lazy-load pinned Mermaid runtime from the same origin on demand, requiring no external CDN and functioning completely offline
Interactive diagram controls featuring zoom (25% to 400%), fit-to-view, and click-and-drag canvas panning
Full-screen diagram overlay mode with Escape key dismissal and dedicated close actions
Maintain diagram SVG cache and yield during batch renders for fluid UI responsiveness
Preserve original code block in DOM for seamless copy and raw Markdown extraction
Isolated error fallbacks ensure invalid diagrams display clear local error cards without breaking neighboring content
Debounced automatic diagram re-rendering when cycling or switching themes

categories.name: Thread Management & Shortcuts
items: Delete threads directly from the thread list via hover trash buttons or Delete/Backspace keyboard shortcuts
Register Threads: Delete Current Thread command in the command palette
Support thread ID via JSON body in delete and cancel endpoints alongside existing query parameters
Add unit tests for thread deletion and cancellation across query parameters and JSON payloads

categories.name: Git Status Synchronization & Trees
items: Trigger real-time git status refreshes across tree and sidebar after staging, unstaging, and committing
Inject all status nodes into index children during git tree updates to ensure complete synchronization
Remove cooldown restrictions from manual refresh triggers for immediate UI response
Evaluate rendered dirty rows when calculating clean tree state to prevent premature fallback
Harden git status UI event handlers with dedicated try-catch blocks and integration tests

categories.name: Themes & Auto-Update
items: Switch default workbench theme to Catppuccin Mocha across settings and documentation
Notify users to restart px0 after background auto-updates instead of abruptly re-executing processes and dropping active connections
